entities.name: PMID:25076957
observations: In 353 carotid endarterectomy patients with preoperative CT, WMLs independently predicted long-term mortality over median 67 months after adjustment for age, diabetes, peripheral arterial disease, stenosis degree, and indication category.
Adjusted hazard ratio for WMLs was 3.83 (95% CI 1.17–12.5; p<0.05).

entities.name: PMID:32331995
observations: In 1,038 symptomatic high-grade carotid stenosis patients undergoing CEA, imaging-reported cerebral small-vessel disease including WMLs was associated with 3-year cardiovascular death.
Adjusted hazard ratio was 2.52 (95% CI 1.12–5.67; p=0.026); no significant association was found with 3-year stroke or 30-day outcomes.

entities.name: Preoperative white matter lesions
observations: Preoperative cerebral WMLs on CT, or imaging-reported small-vessel disease including WMLs, were independently associated with later mortality outcomes after CEA in the cited observational cohorts.

entities.name: Carotid endarterectomy
observations: The relevant studies evaluated patients undergoing carotid endarterectomy for carotid stenosis, including internal carotid artery disease.
